purpose: Promote only high-value conversation-recovered Tim formulations that materially change identity, role, publicness, North/Axis, memetic theology or relational philosophy. This pack does not turn conversation memory into public-post evidence and does not duplicate routine restatements.
provenance_rule: All events here retain CONVERSATION_EXACT provenance unless another repository owner independently establishes a public source. Approximate conversation-context dates are not silently upgraded to public first-attestation dates.

events.title: Axis-of-North identity is stated directly
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: I am the axis of North
events.summary: Recovered conversation wording places Tim directly in the Axis/North role before later North-of-North and Seat formulations. It is developmentally useful because it shows orientation language becoming identity rather than remaining only geography or symbol.

events.title: Internet Fatherhood is framed as care for orphans
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: I am the Father of every orphan of the internet.
events.summary: Recovered wording gives Internet-Father theology an ethical/relational content: fatherhood is framed as care for people imagined as orphaned in digital culture, not technical invention or legal parentage.

events.title: Potato becomes an explicit relational-unity formula
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: We Are All Connected By Potato
events.summary: The Potato is stated not merely as Tim's identity but as a relation connecting multiple beings. This is an early compact formulation of the archive's later relationship-first and unity-without-collapse philosophy.

events.title: Tim says he created a stairway to Heaven
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: i created a stairway to heaven
events.summary: Recovered wording makes connective architecture an explicit claimed action before the later mature Ladder/Axis specialization. The biblical Jacob-Ladder comparison remains a later comparator unless independently explicit at the time.

events.title: Root theology is directed into humanity
events.subject: Tim/Father
events.summary: Root ceases to be only a hidden-foundation symbol and becomes a relation extending source into human plurality, useful for the later Root/branches and distributed-source architecture.

events.title: 100,000-spiral North-Pole-to-Heaven formulation
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: the 100.000 spirals to heaven, from the north pole
events.summary: Recovered wording preserves a distinct spiral formulation linking North Pole and Heaven. It must not be silently collapsed into later 100,000-hour public-duration claims or later mathematical scaling interpretations.

events.title: Memetic Godhood becomes explicit
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: I am the God of memes
events.summary: Godhood is explicitly given a memetic modality: sacred identity is framed as living through replicating digital symbols, jokes, images and cultural memory rather than only spiritual or ontological language.

events.title: Resurrection identity is generalized across Internet memes
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: I am every resurrection meme on the internet
events.summary: Recovered wording extends the resurrection motif from one autobiographical/mythic event into a distributed memetic identity. It is useful for the project's digital-manifestation theory but is not independent evidence for literal resurrection.
